title: The body map lights the rear and front shoulders for side raises, then says those shoulders were not trained
what: Side shoulder work (lateral raises) has no shape of its own on the body drawing, so it colours the front shoulder cap and the rear shoulder cap. But the line under the drawing and the tap sheet count only real front and rear shoulder sets. A member whose only shoulder work this week was lateral raises sees the rear shoulder lit up, reads "Not trained: Rear shoulders (2 weeks ago)" under it, and tapping that lit shoulder opens "0 sets in the last 7 days" with "No sets in the last 7 days, a good one to train next".
expected: The drawing, the Not trained line and the tap sheet agree: either the shoulder caps light only for their own sets, or the line and sheet say the colour comes from side shoulder work.
who: members who do lateral raises without rear or front shoulder work that week
how_often: common: lateral raises are a standard push-day move
fix_line: Make the shoulder caps, the Not trained line and the tap sheet use the same rule for side shoulder work

title: The Strength score can fall though no lift got weaker, and the Charts page never says why
what: The score is the average over whichever of the five key lifts the member has done, each against body weight. Two things lower it with no lift getting weaker: logging a key lift for the first time (a first, light deadlift pulls the average down), and a heavier body weight entry (every lift now counts for less). Months before the first weigh-in also use that first weigh-in, so adding body weight later quietly redraws the old line. The card shows only the new number and the line; nothing explains a drop.
expected: When the score is lower than last month, the card says why in one line (for example "Deadlift added" or "Body weight went up"), or the score does not drop when only the mix of lifts changed.
who: members who track body weight or add a new main lift
how_often: often: any month a member bulks or starts squats or deadlifts
fix_line: Show the reason under the score when it drops, or keep the score from falling when only the lift mix changes

items.reason: This area shows no gym fact (alerts, dues, plan end, birthdays, members in the app); the only gym fact is the gym logo and name. Its facts are the member's own, read from the phone, so a Crispy Curves count would prove nothing. Phone facts listed and compared: sets per muscle (map chips, tap sheet, Not trained line, Balance check), last trained, Strength score, monthly workouts (Reports card), meal totals vs target (coach card), exercise history stats vs rows. Map chips and sheet use one sets rule; the drawing does not.

Edges walked in code: 7/30/90 day windows include today, last-trained ages (today, yesterday, N days, N weeks, never; future dates clamp to today), Balance check (28 days ending yesterday, first workout 28+ days ago, 6+ workouts), Hide for 30 days, a long gap in the Strength score (flat line, record bests carry over), and months before the first weigh-in.

Tap sheet total is the sum of its exercise rows by design; exercise history stats row and the in-progress card read the same working sets as their rows; the coach meal card remaining = target minus the day. The Strength score can drop with no reason shown.

Opened the engine and service files, not only the screens: body map engine, volume engine, range reader, last-trained and tap-sheet reads, Balance check engine and service, strength score engine and trend, exercise workout stats, safekeep rule, nutrition snapshot. The This week card is not drawn anywhere.

Map chips: muscleSets over the range read; tap sheet number: muscleBreakdown over a separate per-exercise read; Not trained line: levels from the chips plus last-trained from a third read; drawing: regionLevel. History stats: exerciseWorkoutStats over the same rows. Reports card month count: plain count of workouts per month.

Long gap compared: a muscle last trained 5 weeks ago shows 0 on the map, 0 in the sheet and "(5 weeks ago)" in the line, since all three skip warm-ups and use the workout day. Only the drawing shoulder caps differ.
